_comment: Two violations the policy must refuse. Case 1 is the reversion the founder predicted: a session writes a fresh Python guard instead of a Rego rule. Case 2 is the quieter version: nobody adds a file, somebody just grows an existing one. Case 3 is the reversion the line ceiling cannot see: the file did not grow, it grew three more refusals. Case 4 is a Python file under policy/, which is where the last one actually lived.
